notes: Customer profile: mid-market B2B SaaS — in-app AI assistant for product analytics workflows.
Primary requirement: sub-300ms 95th latency for short chat turns (UI snappy).
Trial observations (hosted): avg QPS ~3.5 during workday, burst to 12 QPS during feature launch; concurrency observed 6-12 sessions.
